title: The first card arrived.
format: static, 1 slide, 1080x1440 (3:4); the owner's approved photo plate, kept clean (no eyebrow, seal, bracket, wordmark, label or price), with one stray glint healed on the plaster (07-baguette-tennis-bracelet-story-clean.png)
date: Fri 20 Nov 2026 (eve of Tulsi Vivah, Sat 21 Nov)
caption:
The first wedding card of the season arrived on a Thursday. She said yes before reading the venue.

Tulsi Vivah is tomorrow, and the season opens with it. The Baguette Tennis Bracelet in Crystal, ₹1,599: rectangular baguettes set crosswise in gold-tone claws. Also in red and green.

With the matching necklace and huggies it becomes a set. Take 2 pieces for 10% off or 3 for 20% off. Your bag applies the code, BUY2 or BUY3, by itself.

Today's mangal: Malayalam, മംഗളം.

[ baguette tennis bracelet · 18k gold tone plated · rsvp: yes ]
alt_text: A generated still life: a blank ivory wedding invitation with a gold-foil border and a small gold-foil paisley, a sprig of baby's breath, and a gold-tone tennis bracelet of clear rectangular stones lying across the card's lower-left corner on pale plaster. Text: The first card arrived. She said yes before reading the venue. Mangal, മംഗളം.
posting_notes: AI label ON by default: when posting, switch on Instagram's AI label (Advanced settings > Add AI label, or wherever the app puts it on the day) for this upload, whichever of the two files goes out (s01.jpg or s01-fallback-noscript.jpg), and the same for P5. Leave it off only if the owner has opted out in writing before posting; then both alt texts go back to 'A still life:' (see gate_ai_label). Nothing on the image changes either way.

Malayalam gate: post s01.jpg with the Malayalam caption only if a named Malayalam reader signs s01@2x.png on the posting morning; otherwise post the if_malayalam_reader_has_not_signed files and caption.

Posting morning (Fri 20 Nov): re-read Shopify for the Baguette Tennis Bracelet (₹1,599; Crystal 29, Ruby 9, Emerald 16 on 27 Oct) and the necklace and huggies the caption names. The image carries no price, so only the caption could change.
Instagram takes the 3:4 master (s01.jpg). The 4:5 files are only for a scheduler that refuses 3:4; they are composed for 4:5 (see deviations), not a blind centre crop.
Paste the first comment within a minute of posting.
owner_questions: AI label, ON by default (you only need to answer to opt out): the plate is a generated, photoreal still life of a piece we sell, and its baguettes are visibly shorter and wider than in the listing photo (assets/shopify/baguette-tennis-bracelet/02.jpg; side by side at 3x in render/option-b/p11/_work/stone-proportion.png), so a viewer would take it for the real product. research/design-rules.md says generated material must be labelled wherever a viewer could mistake it for the real thing (line 276, and the pre-flight box at line 420). So P11 and P5 go up with Instagram's AI label on, and their alt text starts 'A generated still life:'. If you want either posted without the label, tell us in writing before it posts. The image stays as it is either way.

gate_ai_label.status: DEFAULT ON: switch on Instagram's AI label for both P11 files (s01.jpg and s01-fallback-noscript.jpg) and for P5, unless the owner opts out in writing before posting.
gate_ai_label.question: None to answer for the label to go on. The only open item is an opt-out: does the owner, in writing and before posting, ask for this upload to go up without the label?
gate_ai_label.why: research/design-rules.md line 276: 'Generated or illustrative material must be labelled synthetic wherever a viewer could mistake it for the real thing', and the pre-flight box at line 420 ('Synthetic imagery labelled where it could be mistaken for real'). This is a photoreal generated image of a piece for sale (assets/artifacts/approved-ads/ads/07-baguette-tennis-bracelet-story.jpg, owner-approved 23 Oct), and its baguettes are visibly shorter and wider than the listing's (listing 02.jpg; _work/stone-proportion.png), so a viewer will take it for the real product. With the rule written as a 'must', the post cannot go live unlabelled just because nobody answered. P5's note adds that India's 2026 IT Rules amendment on synthetically generated information makes this a live requirement too: confirm the rule's current text and where Instagram's setting sits on the posting morning.
gate_ai_label.image_changes: None. The label is a setting on the upload; the pixels stay as they are.
gate_ai_label.applies_to: Both P11 files (s01.jpg and s01-fallback-noscript.jpg use the same plate; the 4:5 files too if a scheduler posts those) and P5.
gate_ai_label.decided_by: Rule, not a person: research/design-rules.md line 276 and pre-flight line 420, applied at the art director's review (fix 1).
gate_ai_label.alt_text_rule: Labelled (the default): both alt texts start 'A generated still life:', as alt_text[0] and if_malayalam_reader_has_not_signed.alt_text[0] now do, so the screen-reader text says what the upload setting says. Only if the owner opts out in writing do both revert to 'A still life:'.
gate_ai_label.P5: P5's own post.json still records its gate as OPEN with decision null (render/option-b/p05/post.json, gate_ai_label). It needs the same change (DEFAULT ON, alt text 'A generated still life:' on tile A) so the two plates get the same treatment; not edited from this P11 pass.
